verdict.rationale: The axis applies because AMD's Instinct ecosystem ships its own job scheduler, Spur, described as an "AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm." However, the evidence only describes GPU-first job scheduling with Raft-based state. It never documents recurring or cron-style schedules or workflow orchestration. One-off batch scheduling cannot stand in for a recurring schedule, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
